name: implement-review
description: Plan a task, implement it, review the result, and run tests.

nodes.title: Plan
nodes.instructions: Inspect the requested task and produce a concrete task list. Do not modify the repository.

nodes.title: Implement
nodes.instructions: Implement the planned work. Report completed task IDs with evidence, changed files, and validation. Do not commit or publish.

nodes.title: Review
nodes.instructions: Review the implementation against the task list. Report approval or concrete changes needed. Do not modify files.

nodes.title: Run tests
nodes.instructions: Run the relevant tests and report their observed results. Do not change repository sources, commit, or publish.

connections.condition: The required tests passed and the task checklist is complete.
The tests failed and an implementation change is needed.
